steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Advertising is a paid form of persuasive communication that aims to promote products, services, or ideas to target audiences through various media platforms.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Marketing encompasses the broader strategy of identifying, anticipating, and satisfying customer requirements profitably — advertising is one tool within the marketing mix.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Persuasive techniques include: emotional appeal, fear, humour, celebrity endorsement, bandwagon (everyone's doing it), testimonials, rhetorical questions, and superlatives ('the best').

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: AIDA model: Attention (grab the audience), Interest (hold it), Desire (create want), Action (prompt purchase). Most adverts follow this structure.

steps.body: Always identify the persuasive techniques used in specific CSP adverts Discuss the target audience using demographic and psychographic terms Consider regulatory context — ASA rules, CAP code, Ofcom for broadcast ads
